criterion: held-out L2 (neg_plain_loss), 6-seed mean, focal C1/C5: any attributor rho >= 0.5 * measured 6-seed ceiling AND one-sided p < 0.025 (Bonferroni-2)
interpretation: PASS => Phase-1 Gate-1 failure was the noise floor. FAIL at a high ceiling => attribution is genuinely unfaithful at demo grain in this regime.
